title: Appeal of Gatis v. Northeast
disposition_detail: The full SJC approved the appellant’s request to withdraw Case 99-3. The SJC separately considered Adams’s related complaint out of order under BCO 43-1; that ruling did not dispose of the withdrawn appeal.
first_summary: A minister appealed an unidentified Presbytery judgment but later requested withdrawal. The full SJC approved the request, ending the appeal without a merits decision. A related complaint was held out of order under BCO 43-1.
